description:
Check video generation and publishing status

Returns a status snapshot in `data.video` (not a flat `data` object). For publishing, use `data.video.publishing` as the source of truth: per-platform state and `retryable` determine retry safety. The legacy `video.status` remains `published`, `partial`, or `failed`; when publishing needs review, it is `partial` if any platform succeeded and otherwise `failed`.
name: getVideoStatus
